long_biography.plain_text:
Homebuilder Sergio Pino linked housing design to the daily routines of prospective buyers. At Midtown Doral, his mixed-use approach placed homes near shops, gyms and restaurants, amenities he considered particularly important to younger buyers. His sales centre used virtual presentations and three-dimensional designs to help customers visualise properties before choosing a home.

Pino also helped endow an entrepreneurship centre at Florida International University. The family gift qualified for matching state funds, enlarging the resources available for teaching, research and business advice. The centre brought together work on family enterprises, technology and community innovation, with programmes open to students and local people starting or expanding businesses.
